test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The base of a right prism is a rectangle with sides 8 cm and 5 cm. The height of the prism is 12 cm. What is the total surface area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Base Perimeter = 2 × (8 + 5) = 26 cm

Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter × Height = 26 × 12 = 312 cm²

Base Area = 8 × 5 = 40 cm²

Total Surface Area = LSA + 2 × Base Area = 312 + 80 = 392 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 392 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of rectangular base (l) = 8 cm

Width of rectangular base (w) = 5 cm

Height of prism (h) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Base Area

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) = Perimeter of base × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4289609a737399f5740503ef7faf29c96ba9b0d7125595d482e413f37d96b0fb.png] 

⇒ Base Area = l × w

⇒ Base Area = 8 × 5 = 40 cm²

⇒ Perimeter of base = 2 × (l + w)

⇒ Perimeter of base = 2 × (8 + 5) = 2 × 13 = 26 cm

⇒ LSA = 26 × 12 = 312 cm²

⇒ TSA = LSA + 2 × Base Area

⇒ TSA = 312 + 2 × 40

⇒ TSA = 312 + 80 = 392 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 392 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Prism

The volume of any right prism is given by the formula: Volume = Base Area × Height.

Diagonal of a Rectangular Prism

The longest diagonal connecting two opposite corners is calculated as d = √(l² + w² + h²).

Surface Area of a Cube

If all sides of the rectangular base and the height are equal (l = w = h = a), the TSA of the resulting cube is 6a².</p
